A copy of sample.jpg: the owner decided on #261 that BIN to JPG and PNG read a binary file that holds an image. Apache-2.0: its notice and a full copy of the License are beside it, in tika-drm.m4p.NOTICE and tika-drm.m4p.LICENSE. Read back with xxd (a drms sample entry holding a sinf box: frma mp4a, schm itun) and ffprobe (aac, codec tag drms, 44.1 kHz stereo, 1 s, no samples). M4P to MP3 must refuse it as copy-protected (#267).

docx-to-jpeg.notes: Three US Letter pages with two page breaks saved in the file: a title, headings, a PNG chart, a table and a numbered list. Made with pandoc 3.9 from Markdown (the chart with magick), then pandoc's sectPr, which has no page size, replaced by a US Letter page with 1-inch margins (w:pgSz 12240x15840, w:pgMar 1440). Read back with textutil (all the text) and `file` (Microsoft Word 2007+); its document.xml holds two w:br w:type="page", so three pages (PAGE_COUNTS in scripts/lib/tool-sweep.mjs).

docx-to-svg.notes: Four US Letter pages with no page break saved in the file, so every page after the first is one the converter continues itself: a title and 30 one-line paragraphs that run past the first page, then a 3-column table (GROUP | ITEM | PRICE) of a header row marked to repeat on each page (w:tblHeader) and 70 items in two groups, the GROUP cell of each merged down its group (w:vMerge) across a page's end, with rows merged across columns (w:gridSpan: three 'discontinued' items over ITEM and PRICE, and two subtotals over GROUP and ITEM), then a closing paragraph; a page header and footer. Every line and row has an exact height (w:lineRule exact, w:hRule exact), so the pages break in the same places with any font. Written as WordprocessingML by a Python script with zipfile (no Word, pandoc or download). Read back with textutil (all the text) and `file` (Microsoft Word 2007+). scripts/smoke-browser.mjs checks each page's table cells sit under their header; PAGE_COUNTS in scripts/lib/tool-sweep.mjs has its page count.

Read back with `file` (AutoCAD Drawing Exchange Format, version 2000) and a group-code parser: HEADER, TABLES and ENTITIES sections, 13 entities, ending in EOF.

txt-to-jpg.notes: Eleven lines of UTF-8 text written as plain text: a pangram each in Latin (with accents), Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew and Arabic, a tab-indented line, a line long enough to wrap and a word too long for a line. Read back with `file` (Unicode text, UTF-8 text) and `wc -l`.

txt-to-svg.notes: The fixture txt-to-jpg uses; see its notes.

dot-to-jpg.notes: A styled Graphviz graph written as plain text: two clusters, a record node, an HTML-like label, colours, edge labels and a rank set (left to right). Read back with @hpcc-js/wasm-graphviz 1.29.2 (Graphviz 16.1.0, a different build from the app's Viz.js) in a scratch folder: 5 nodes, 4 edges, 2 clusters.

xlsx-to-jpg.notes: Three sheets written as SpreadsheetML by a Python script with zipfile (no Excel or download): Sales (dates, #,##0, a custom "$"#,##0.00 and 0% formats, booleans, SUM formulas with cached results, a hidden row and a hidden column), Payroll (hidden) and Notes (Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew and Arabic text). Read back with `file` (Microsoft Excel 2007+) and macOS Quick Look (qlmanage -t), which draws Sales without its hidden row and column. Two sheets show, so two images (PAGE_COUNTS in scripts/lib/tool-sweep.mjs); xlsx-sheets.test.mjs checks each cell's text and that nothing hidden is read.

pptx-to-jpg.notes: Three 16:9 slides written by pptxgenjs 4.0.1 in a scratch folder (no PowerPoint or download): a title, a bulleted list with Greek, Cyrillic and Hebrew, an embedded PNG made with magick, a rounded rectangle, an arrow and a circle; a slide marked hidden afterwards by a Python script with zipfile (<p:sld show="0">); a table with row heights and a column chart, with speaker notes. Read back with `file` (Microsoft PowerPoint 2007+) and macOS Quick Look (qlmanage -t), which draws the first slide. Two slides show, so two images (PAGE_COUNTS in scripts/lib/tool-sweep.mjs); pptx-slides.test.mjs checks the hidden slide and the notes aren't drawn.

bin-to-png.notes: A TIFF saved with a .bin name: a 96x96 navy-to-orange gradient with a white square, 8-bit, LZW, made with magick 7.1.2. Read back with file (TIFF image data, LZW) and magick identify (TIFF 96x96 8-bit, 97 colours).

bin-to-jpeg.notes: A HEIC saved with a .bin name: the picture in sample-tiff.bin, 8-bit, quality 80, made with magick 7.1.2 (libheif 1.20.2). Read back with file (HEIF Image HEVC Main) and magick identify (HEIC 96x96 8-bit, 124 colours).
